verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt (HTTP 200) on Shopify's Help Center, which hosts the Shopify POS manual. It is explicitly titled as a guide for AI agents and crawlers, and the POS docs are served as .md pages an agent can fetch. The probe-2 404 was for a malformed doubled `.md.md` URL, so it does not contradict this. Missing for 10: llms.txt content beyond its header is unverified, it is a Help Center-wide file rather than POS-specific, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
